notes: Employees by country from the FY2026 Form 10-K (Jun 30, 2026): U.S. ~7,900, U.K. ~3,900, Australia ~5,600 of ~21,700; the remaining ~4,300 are not broken out. The FY2026 10-K's Item 2 is much shorter than FY2025's: it names only the New York headquarters at 1211 Avenue of the Americas, The News Building in London, 2 Holt Street in Sydney and the Adelaide print center and office building, and otherwise says the Company owns interests in publishing and printing facilities in England and Scotland leased to its joint venture with DMG Media and leases other space across the U.S., Europe, Australia and Asia. Those four sites are re-sourced to the FY2026 10-K; the Sydney entry now follows the FY2026 wording (2 Holt Street, which houses News Corp Australia's headquarters and the printing and publishing operations for The Australian, The Daily Telegraph and The Sunday Telegraph). The other sites (HarperCollins U.S. in New York, the South Brunswick campus, Move in Austin, the Broxbourne printing facility, HarperCollins Glasgow, the Melbourne print center, REA Group in Melbourne and Dow Jones Hong Kong) are not named in the FY2026 10-K but it does not say they were sold or closed, so they stay on their FY2025 10-K source. No state or tax-by-country data in the 10-K.
